title: Auto satin turns a 120° bend as PE-DESIGN does
description: A 5 mm band bent through 120° in satin with Auto direction, density 3, without under sewing, Half Stitch on: every other crowded needle point on the inner side of the bend is pulled back along its crossing (PE-DESIGN's needle points 60, 64 … 88 move 0.8 to 2.4 mm against satin-auto-bend-120-nohalf; mean stitch length 4.58 mm with it on, 4.75 mm off, within 0.25 mm), and the rung direction turns with the distance along the outer edge, as in PE-DESIGN's file (count within 10 %, longest crossing within 0.5 mm). The 120 degree band (second leg 17.32 mm on the outside, 8.66 mm inside): PE-DESIGN 11.50 sews square rungs on both legs and a fan of crossings up to 9.6 mm round the bend, its outer needle points 1/3 mm apart along the outer edge (161 stitches as the harness counts them; parked in round 3, landed 2026-10-30).

featureMatrix.feature: Satin: a zigzag across the column

evidence.note: PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/satin-auto-bend-120.pes (pe-refs-3 bend sweep, 2026-10-28): 175 stitches; the same count with Half Stitch on and off.

references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page draw (or import from SVG) the closed polygon (0,0) (30,0) (21.34,15) (17.01,12.5) (21.34,5) (0,5) mm (a 5 mm band bent through 120°). Line Not Sewn; region Satin Stitch, Direction Auto, Half Stitch ticked, Density 3.0, Under Sewing off, other attributes default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: the longest crossings are in the corner fan
Half Stitch shortens every other crossing at the bend's inner side: PE-DESIGN's mean stitch is 4.58 mm with it on, 4.75 mm with it off (satin-auto-bend-120-nohalf)
